'''Gaulix''' the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Ansion (star)|Ansion]] in the [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Gaulix had one [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and was essentially a [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] soup.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion system]], except [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
